How to read changes

Same task means the mathematical inputs and requested result repeat; it does not promise identical punctuation or option order. Amber words and values differ from the selected reference transcription. Hover or tap a highlight to inspect the change. The original scan is the authority for exact wording, options and diagrams.

8-mark questions.

Five compulsory unit slots, Q21–25, each with an OR. Choose your stronger method, but learn at least one backup in every unit.

15-mark questions.

Answer one of the two choices. Prepare a complete Warshall solution and a full coding decoder, not just an 8-mark codeword exercise.

Audit methodology and source defects

Eight distinct May 2024–May 2026 exam versions, including two distinct July 2025 versions. Each modern paper contains 20 MCQs, 5×8 Part B with OR and 1×15 from two options. Counts are per paper; a split option is explicitly labeled. Some original MCQs and matrix dimensions have typographical errors; read notes rather than blindly memorizing option letters. No official answer key supplied. Gemini's seven-paper audit was used only as a comparison, not as ground truth.
